title: Sickle Cell Anemia Eradication Mission (Budget 2023-24):
summary: Schemes — Sickle Cell Anemia Eradication Mission (Budget 2023-24):

items:  Objective: Eliminate sickle cell anemia by 2047.
 Screening: Universal screening of 7 crore people up to 40 years of age, focusing on tribal areas.
 Focus: Early detection, genetic counseling, and strengthening healthcare infrastructure.
 Goal: Reduce the prevalence of sickle cell anemia through awareness and medical support.
